title: Data Structures & Algorithms — Problem Bank
description: Curated interview problems organized by topic and difficulty

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an array of integers and a target, return indices of two numbers that add up to the target.
problems.hint: Use a hash map to store each number's index. For each element, check if (target - element) exists in the map.
followUps: What if the array is sorted? → Use two pointers O(n) O(1)
What if there are multiple valid pairs?
What if you need to return the values, not indices?

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description: Given an array, return true if any value appears at least twice.
problems.hint: Add each element to a set. If you see a duplicate, return true immediately.
followUps: Can you do it without extra space? → Sort first O(n log n) O(1)

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s.
problems.hint: Count character frequencies. Or sort both strings and compare.
followUps: What about multiple anagram groups? → Group Anagrams

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.description: Given an array of strings, group anagrams together.
problems.hint: Sort each string to get a key. Use a hash map: key → list of anagrams.
problems.timeComplexity: O(n × k log k) where k = max string length
followUps: Can you avoid sorting? → Use character count as key

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.description: Given an array and integer k, return the k most frequent elements.
problems.hint: Count frequencies, then use min-heap of size k. Or use bucket sort by frequency.

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.description: Given an array, return an array where output[i] = product of all elements except nums[i]. Cannot use division.
problems.hint: Compute prefix products left to right, then suffix products right to left.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.description: Given a string, determine if it is a palindrome (ignoring non-alphanumeric and case).
problems.hint: Two pointers from both ends. Skip non-alphanumeric characters.

problems.title: Two Sum II (Input Array Is Sorted)
problems.description: Given a sorted array and target, find two numbers that sum to target. Return 1-based indices.
problems.hint: Left pointer at start, right at end. Move inward based on sum vs target.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.description: Find all unique triplets that sum to zero.
problems.hint: Sort array. Fix first element, then use two pointers for remaining pair. Skip duplicates.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.description: Find two lines that form a container with the most water.
problems.hint: Two pointers at ends. Move the shorter one inward. Why? Moving the taller one can only decrease area.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.description: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
problems.hint: Sliding window with a set. Shrink from left when duplicate found.
problems.spaceComplexity: O(min(m, n)) where m = charset size

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.description: Find the minimum window in s that contains all characters of t.
problems.hint: Expand right, track character counts. When all chars found, shrink from left. Track minimum window.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description: Determine if the input string of brackets is valid (every opening has matching closing).
problems.hint: Push opening brackets. When closing bracket appears, check if it matches the top of stack.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and getMin in O(1) time.
problems.hint: Maintain a parallel stack of minimum values, or store (value, min_at_this_point) tuples.

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.description: Given daily temperatures, return an array where answer[i] = days to wait for a warmer temperature.
problems.hint: Monotonic decreasing stack. Store indices. Pop while current temp > stack top temp.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.description: Find the largest rectangular area in a histogram.
problems.hint: Monotonic increasing stack. When a bar is shorter than stack top, calculate area using popped bar as height.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.description: Reverse a singly linked list.
problems.hint: Iterative: three pointers (prev, curr, next). Reverse one link at a time.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.description: Detect if a linked list has a cycle.
problems.hint: Slow and fast pointers. If they meet → cycle exists.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
problems.hint: Dummy head node. Compare and link nodes one by one.

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.description: Reorder list to L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln-1 → L2 → Ln-2 → ...
problems.hint: 1) Find middle with fast/slow. 2) Reverse second half. 3) Merge two halves alternately.

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.description: Design an LRU cache with get and put in O(1) time.
problems.hint: Hash map: key → node. Doubly linked list for order. Move to head on access. Remove tail when full.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.description: Find the maximum depth (height) of a binary tree.
problems.hint: Recursive: 1 + max(depth(left), depth(right)). Base case: null → 0.

problems.title: Same Tree
problems.description: Check if two binary trees are identical.
problems.hint: Both null → true. One null → false. Values must match and both subtrees must be same.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of BST
problems.description: Find the lowest common ancestor of two nodes in a BST.
problems.hint: If both nodes are smaller → go left. If both larger → go right. Otherwise → current node is LCA.

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.description: Return level-order traversal (each level as a list).
problems.hint: BFS with queue. Process all nodes at current level before moving to next.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.description: Determine if a binary tree is a valid BST.
problems.hint: Each node must be in range (min, max). Left subtree < node < right subtree.

problems.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder
problems.description: Build a binary tree from its preorder and inorder traversal arrays.
problems.hint: First element of preorder = root. Find root in inorder to split left/right subtrees.
problems.timeComplexity: O(n²) naive, O(n) with hash map

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.description: You can climb 1 or 2 steps. How many ways to reach the top?
problems.hint: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]. This is Fibonacci.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.description: Max sum of non-adjacent numbers in an array.
problems.hint: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]). Either skip current house or rob it.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.description: Find minimum number of coins to make up a given amount.
problems.hint: dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-coin] + 1) for each coin. Initialize with infinity, dp[0]=0.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.description: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
problems.hint: DP: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j]) for all j < i where nums[j] < nums[i]. O(n²). Binary search approach: O(n log n).

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.description: Find the length of the LCS of two strings.
problems.hint: dp[i][j]: if chars match → dp[i-1][j-1]+1, else → max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

problems.title: Word Break
problems.description: Determine if a string can be segmented into dictionary words.
problems.hint: dp[i] = true if any dp[j] is true and s[j:i] is in dictionary.
